response.overview: Following the Fourth Technological Revolution, gifted young detective and cosplayer Shen Meng develops extraordinary physical abilities, while his roommate Yun Sheng mysteriously transforms into a woman. As they discover that superpowered cosplayers are being hunted, a distress message from renowned scientist Dr. Jin Einstein draws them into an investigation uncovering a shocking conspiracy.
response.title: 好哒主公之邪灵之魄
